verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows extensive integrations (webhooks, API, third-party security scanners, IaC tools) and a robust REST API for building custom automation, but nothing documents official support for swapping GitLab's native CI/CD engine for an external CI/CD tool (e.g., Jenkins, CircleCI, TravisCI) as a replacement runner/orchestrator. One community note even states third-party CI services like TravisCI generally don't integrate with GitLab, reinforcing the gap. missing for 10: any documentation of connecting/using an external CI/CD orchestrator instead of GitLab's native pipelines, official integration guides for competing CI tools, evidence of webhook-triggered external pipeline execution replacing GitLab CI.
